VeraGridEngine.Simulations.OPF.Formulations.linear_opf_ts.add_facility_battery_constraints(t: int, global_t: int | None, facility_groups: Dict[Facility, FacilityDispatchGroup], nc: NumericalCircuit, mip_vars: OpfVars, prob: PulpLpModel | OrToolsLpModel, skip_generation_limits: bool) → None[source]

Limit restricted battery flows to their facility’s actual production and demand.

Budgets use gross generation and served demand, without prioritizing local consumption over charging. Grid-mode batteries do not consume these budgets.

Parameters:

  • t – Local optimization time index.

  • global_t – Profile time index, or None for snapshot values.

  • facility_groups – Precomputed device references and compiled indices per facility.

  • nc – Compiled circuit at the profile time index.

  • mip_vars – Optimization variables, in per unit.

  • prob – Optimization model.

  • skip_generation_limits – Whether generator power bounds are disabled.

Returns:

None.

Add a piecewise-linear approximation of one generator quadratic variable cost.

The helper approximates cost_2 * p^2 + cost_1 * p with an incremental convex envelope over [0, pmax]. This keeps the formulation linear/MIP while activating the otherwise-unused cost_2 coefficient.

Parameters:

  • local_t – Local time index.

  • k – Generator index.

  • Sbase – System base power in MVA.

  • gen_data_t – Generator data container.

  • gen_vars – Generator variable container.

  • prob – Linear/MIP model instance.

  • producing_var – Commitment/on-off indicator used to disable segments when the unit is off.

  • segment_count – Number of linear segments for the approximation.

Returns:

Linear expression representing the approximated variable cost.

VeraGridEngine.Simulations.OPF.Formulations.linear_opf_ts.get_generator_cost_expression(local_t: int, k: int, Sbase: float, gen_data_t: GeneratorData, gen_vars: GenerationVars, prob: PulpLpModel | OrToolsLpModel, use_glsk_as_cost: bool, quadratic_costs: bool, producing_var: LpVariable | Variable | int | float | None = None, starting_up_var: LpVariable | Variable | int | float | None = None, shutting_down_var: LpVariable | Variable | int | float | None = None) → LpAffineExpression | LinearExpr | float[source]

Build the full operating-cost expression for one generator at one time step.

This helper centralizes the generator operating-cost assembly so the callers only decide which commitment variables exist in their formulation. The production term can stay purely linear, use GLSK weights, or use the piecewise-linear quadratic approximation.

Parameters:

  • local_t – Local time index.

  • k – Generator index.

  • Sbase – System base power in MVA.

  • gen_data_t – Generator data container.

  • gen_vars – Generator variable container.

  • prob – Linear/MIP model instance.

  • use_glsk_as_cost – Use GLSK participation factors instead of generator costs.

  • quadratic_costs – Enable the piecewise-linear quadratic cost approximation.

  • producing_var – Commitment/on-off variable when a no-load term should be commitment-dependent.

  • starting_up_var – Optional startup indicator.

  • shutting_down_var – Optional shutdown indicator.

Returns:

Linear expression representing the operating cost.
